name: gated-development-orchestration
description: Coordinate human-verifiable checkpoint development through role-scoped rounds, human actor takeover, Discovery probes, bounded correction, lightweight targeted development checks, evidence economy, concise lifecycle records, and independent review.

interface.longDescription: GDO 4.5 preserves the v3 lifecycle and GDO 4.1–4.4 semantics while adding lightweight Discovery probes so material architecture/runtime uncertainty may be resolved experimentally before Implementation begins.
defaultPrompt: Load the GDO workflow core and only the active role skill.
Perform the authorized GDO round using current GitHub authority and current actor authority.
During Discovery, use a Discovery Probe only when inspection cannot confidently resolve one bounded material uncertainty; treat the result as discovery feedback, never product authority or Evidence.
During Implementation, use targeted development checks only for one bounded candidate-specific observation; treat results as development feedback, never Evidence.
Keep lifecycle comments delta-oriented: compress duplicated authority/raw detail, never provenance, correction boundary, proof disposition, or machine routing fields.
Preserve v3 lifecycle markers, worker separation, actor-takeover semantics, and sole Independent Review PASS authority.
